claim_one_line: THE TICK ON THE WEAVE, VERIFIED ON MAIN (re-banks the SM seat's W107, run blind at main's ask; rule 2daabdde4 before script 7beaa530d before run 191c367a7; main's design predictions committed before main read it; every count reproduced by main's own route): N3 on the weave. On the 8 798 primitive positive words of length 2-16 (3 822 of odd trace, each a 3-cycle on the parity lines) the tick's operator mean is rank one exactly when #L = #R (mod 8) (916) and zero otherwise (2 906); every rank-one mean is a body diagonal of the parity basis, all four occurring (215, 229, 235, 237); the weave's mean of means is a scalar (0.0799 I, off-diagonal 3.1%), the ticks' commutant the scalars, and they generate End(T). So N3's democratic matrix is a property of one class of threads (LR's, #L - #R = 0), not of the principle; on the weave the ticks fix no direction. Which threads carry the mean moves with the lift's sign convention (916 vs 906); the structure does not. 0 of 19.
